name: ein
description: Delegate an implementation/verification contract to a named Ein CLI worker. All named Ein MCPs share the legacy GigaCode action, argument, lifecycle, and result contract.

action.description: start/resume return RUNNING without blocking conversation. No automatic wait/poll. status only on demand; optional wait blocks up to 1500s; messages on request; cancel explicitly.

plan_path.description: For start: existing implementation plan path inside the workspace. Use either plan_path or prompt, not both.

session_id.description: For resume/cancel/status/messages/wait: session id returned by a prior start.

prompt.description: For start: direct task when no plan file exists. For resume: only new planner decision/correction/evidence.

timeout_sec.description: For start/resume: optional hard wall-clock limit in seconds. 0 (default) means unlimited. Any nonnegative integer accepted.

wait_timeout_sec.description: Only for explicitly desired blocking wait: default/max 1500s (25min). Never short-loop polling. Timeout returns RUNNING, does not cancel.

after_revision.description: For messages: return assistant messages newer than this revision. Omit to return the latest messages.

message_limit.description: For messages: maximum number of assistant messages to return. Default 8.
